description: Searches the Verateca register by product name, brand, ingredient or barcode. Returns up to 10 matches with IDs, brands, page addresses and recent published prices where available. Use detail "full" for the number of offers and more record details. Results are ordered by match, never by payment. Reference data only: it does not cover medication interactions, diagnosis or treatment decisions.

country.description: The United States is the only market currently available.

detail.description: Compact answer by default. Use full for the complete published record.

query.description: Product name, brand, ingredient or barcode (UPC/EAN).

title: Search products
